question: The Trimbakeshwar Temple, which is situated in Nashik, Maharashtra, was built by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balaji Baji Rao**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Trimbakeshwar Temple is located in Nashik, Maharashtra.
 
• It is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, which are considered to be the holiest Shiva temples.
 
• The temple was constructed by **Balaji Baji Rao**, who was also known as Nana Saheb.
 
• Balaji Baji
